Research: how big AI teams code with agents, vs this setup

Date2026-11-22ScopePublic practice of 8 AI and tech orgs vs _ai/ and AGENTS.mdStatusready

Bottom lineThe setup already matches 7 of 10 industry practices. The 3 gaps are all about proof: no hook enforces "done", no evals test the skills, and plans have no requirements layer.

7 of 10Practices matched
2 medium, 2 lowGaps worth fixing
2 of 3 (no Stop)Hook events used

Decide firstShould _ai/ get a Stop hook that runs the project's fast check (lint or typecheck) and blocks "done" while it fails? Recommended: yes.

Medium "Done" is a rule, not a check

Problem
The Verify rule and the task loop's Check are only text. Anthropic: a rule Claude keeps missing "belongs in a hook".
Fix
Have sync.mjs generate a Stop hook that runs the fast check from project.md Commands and exits 2 on red.
If skipped
You keep checking "all tests pass" claims by hand.
Where
settings.json only has UserPromptSubmit and PreToolUse hooks.

Medium No evals test the skills or rules

Problem
node --test covers the code in guard, sync and report. Nothing checks that "plan this" triggers pplan or that replies stay within 5 lines. In METR's 2025 study, developers felt 20% faster but measured 19% slower.
Fix
Turn retro findings into 20-30 eval cases with pass/fail graders. Run them with skill-creator evals or claude plugin eval after every _ai/ change.
If skipped
A rule edit can quietly break behavior that used to work.
Where
_ai/skills/, retro

Low Plans jump from goal to steps

Problem
Kiro and GitHub Spec Kit split work into requirements, design and tasks, approved phase by phase. pplan goes straight from Goal to Steps.
Fix
For features, add an optional ID | WHEN | THE SYSTEM SHALL table (the EARS format) and have Done when cite the IDs.
If skipped
Small tasks are fine. On features, intent and Done when can drift apart.
Where
pplan

Low No unattended agent runs

Problem
Stripe merges over 1,300 agent PRs a week from fixed workflows that mix scripted steps (lint, push) with agent steps, and allow at most 2 CI rounds before a human takes over.
Fix
Optional solo. Later: a GitHub Action running claude -p --max-turns --max-budget-usd on chores.
If skipped
Nothing lost.
Where
test.yml

Industry wraps agents in checks, not trust

Google says 75% of its new code is AI-generated and approved by engineers, and DORA calls AI an amplifier: teams with fast feedback gain, slow teams do not.
